text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I've always loved running, ever since I was little.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Ever since I was little, I wanted to become a strong Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Ever since the old days, I—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I was saved.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Because you existed.
Because you gave me an "absolute" to believe in.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Because you were there,
the very existence known as Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—I was able to be born!)

text_block_list.name: Spe & Grass
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah―――――!!
Yaaahhhhhaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...Even if the closing voices push me.
Even if the path to the future is clouded over.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I can take this step. I can move forward.
From the past—into the future!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "No matter what adversity stands in our way! No matter what sorrow comes to bear!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: This "absolute" will never waver!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The fact that there were Trainers
who nurtured this "absolute"!
That will never change, either!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
As long as "absolute certainty" exists,
my future will—carry on!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Tsurumaru! It's Tsurumaru!
Following the autumn, the absolute champion of the entire year is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The golden prodigy who proclaimed absolute victory!
No one can deny it!
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was—magnificent!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Aaaah... Aaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An overflowing scream echoed across the sky. That voice—which could be called both a cry of joy and a newborn's wail—shook the very soul—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Tsuyoshi—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Can everyone see me!?
I won! I actually won!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The girls who ran today were ridiculously strong!
Yet among those historic stars, I was *definitely* the one shining brightest!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: This is the power of "possibility" born from an "absolute"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's because of "everything up to now"
that we've reached "everything from now on."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Thank you all very much for your support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi bowed deeply.
She looked so splendid, it almost felt like she was glowing—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Voices of congratulations could be heard from the stands as well.
choice_data_list: —! Excuse me, bring her over here!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ......Congratulations, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...President.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for being the person
I look up to, President!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This won't do.
...It's your celebration. Why am I—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think that I would be the one
shaken to the core like this...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, President.
...Please give it to me just as it is.
Give me your feelings.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"And to everyone who watched
the race today! One last thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It is thanks to all of you
that I am able to run!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
To you, who rushed all the way here to see me.
To you, who believed in me in front of your TV.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —And then.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in the "absolute" inside me
even more than I did myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I take Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's outstretched hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And together with her, I raise my hand high toward the heavens.
Held high toward the future that awaits us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loud applause could be heard from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is a gift meant for you,
who were born on that very day."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is a gift meant for you,
who were born on that very day."
